document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text: You contemplate possible routes with your students.

If  you  have  the  keyword  INCHCAPE,  go  to  158. To  explore  a 
nearby canyon, go to 90. To follow the river, go to 60. To use the 
mountains as a landmark, go to 56. To gain elevation where you 
can, go to 552. To explore the deep woods, go to 461.
